query: Something weird: I asked you to open workflow abc123 and n8n_get_workflow came back NOT_FOUND. But I'm literally looking at that workflow open in my n8n UI right now. Did it get deleted? Should I rebuild it?
expected_behavior: Activate n8n-multi-instance and recognize this as a likely wrong-instance misroute, NOT a deletion
Explicitly tell the user NOT to recreate/rebuild the workflow
Diagnose: the unnamed call went to the default instance, which is not the one whose UI they're looking at (another chat may have switched it)
Call n8n_instances({mode:"list"}) to get the names and ask/infer which instance the UI belongs to
Retry n8n_get_workflow({id:"abc123", instance:"<that name>"}) rather than switching
Mention the secondary possibility: if their previously-selected instance was deleted, unnamed calls fall back to the account default
Recommend naming the instance on later calls too
notes: NOT_FOUND on a multi-instance account is a routing problem first. The fix is a named retry, not a rebuild.
